title: Metroid Dread
description: Metroid Dread is a modern 2D action-adventure starring Samus Aran. It emphasizes fast movement, interconnected exploration, upgrades, boss battles, and E.M.M.I. chase sections that give the game its signature tension. This file represents the Nintendo Switch 1 product entry with a Switch 2 compatibility reference.
